How to record audio in OneNote for Mac.
Now, OneNote for Mac offers a ton of features, one of them being the ability to record audio notes.
Now, to do this, it's very simple.
Note that when you click on Audio Recording, it will begin to record immediately.
While it's recording, you can view the level and of course press stop at any time.
You can even add a bookmark once you're finished.
Once you're done, your audio file will be placed within your note.
You can press play or right click on your file and open it with a different media player.
